ArenaDef.description:
Where the boss fights: a sphere round its home, the spot where it first stood on the ground. It targets only
players inside, and pulled out of it, it resets: back home, at full health, in its first phase.

radius.description: The arena's radius in blocks, 4 to 64.
radius.title: Radius

ArenaDef.title: ArenaDef

BossAbilityDef.description:
A spell the boss casts while its phase lasts, whenever the spell is ready and its target in reach. The boss
aims it at its current target; a spell that picks its own target (``random_player``, ``farthest_player``) or acts
on the boss itself (``self``) chooses for itself.

cooldown_seconds.description: The ability's own pause between two casts, on top of the spell's cooldown; 0 (the default): the spell's cooldown alone.
cooldown_seconds.title: Cooldown Seconds

BossAbilityDef.title: BossAbilityDef

BossPhaseDef.description:
One phase of the fight. The first is where the fight starts; every later one has a trigger that enters it from
the phase before, so the phases come in order.

abilities.description: What the boss casts while the phase lasts, most important first.
abilities.title: Abilities

enter_when.description: What enters this phase from the one before; none for the first phase.
enter_when.title: Enter When

id.description: The phase's id, unique within the boss, e.g. awakening.
id.title: Id

name.description: The phase's name in the boss bar, after the boss's name: Title Case, 1 to 3 words (lore style guide), e.g. Stone Fury.

on_enter.description: Spells the boss casts at once when the phase begins, without their cooldowns: a buff on itself, a blast round it. Not for the first phase.

items.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

on_enter.title: On Enter

BossPhaseDef.title: BossPhaseDef

HealthBelowDef.description: The boss's health has fallen below a share of its maximum.

health_percent.description: The share of its maximum health, in percent: 0 to 100.
health_percent.title: Health Percent

HealthBelowDef.title: HealthBelowDef

LocalizedText.description: A player-facing text, keyed by locale. Realmforge ships English only, so en_us is the one locale.
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

TimeInPhaseDef.description: The boss has spent a while in the phase before this one: an enrage timer, or a phase that ends by itself.

after_seconds.description: How long the phase before lasts, in seconds; more than 0.
after_seconds.title: After Seconds

TimeInPhaseDef.title: TimeInPhaseDef

description: A boss's fight, ``realmforge:<id>``: the entity it runs on and its phases.

bar_color.description: The colour of its boss bar: pink, blue, red, green, yellow, purple or white.
bar_color.title: Bar Color

entity.description: Its body: a mob of archetype boss in content/mobs/, realmforge:<mob>. One boss per such mob.
entity.title: Entity

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

level.description: Its fixed level, which scales its attributes like every mob's (architecture 14.1); in a dungeon run it takes the run's level instead.
level.title: Level

phase_change_seconds.description: How long it stands, unhurt and casting nothing, when it enters a new phase, in seconds (research BM-2: 3 s); 0 for no pause. Particles round it show it.
phase_change_seconds.title: Phase Change Seconds

phases.description: Its phases, in the order the fight goes through.
phases.title: Phases
